name: Richard Acquistapace
headline: Executive Leader - Operations and Service Delivery
about:
A highly accomplished leader with 25+ years of experience driving operational excellence and transformative change across diverse organizations, including Thales, Ingenico, NTT Data, and VeriFone. I excel at building and leading high-performing teams that consistently exceed KPIs and meet customer SLAs, optimizing processes for maximum efficiency, and delivering large-scale projects that achieve significant cost savings and improve service delivery.

My leadership has consistently resulted in:
Thales: Successful service transformations encompassing digitization, global service desk implementation, and strategic innovation initiatives.

Ingenico: Leading multiple operational transformations across a large, geographically dispersed team in Australia and New Zealand, encompassing field services, call centres, repair centres, logistics, and supply chain.

NTT Data: Optimized field service operations, reduced maintenance work orders, and increased terminal availability for the Myki Ticketing System.

VeriFone: Improved customer turnaround times, reduced backlogs, and boosted service output without increasing resource costs.

I am a skilled communicator with a proven track record of engaging with C-level stakeholders and driving impactful change. I am passionate about collaborating with like-minded professionals to achieve exceptional results.
… more

experiences.description:
As Head of Services Delivery for Thales across the APAC region, I led a large-scale service transformation initiative focused on enhancing operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. 

This involved establishing a global 24/7 emergency service desk, spearheading the digitization of services, and standardizing service offerings across the region. By collaborating closely with key stakeholders, I developed a comprehensive service transformation roadmap that drove innovation and improvements in service quality. I also championed a shift towards a services-driven business model, transforming Thales’ operational mindset, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. 

Key achievements included the implementation of a standardized incident management model, introduction of stable software release initiatives, and the development of detailed policies and procedures to ensure operational consistency and compliance.

Led strategy execution and talent development within the Service Engineering organization at Thales. Successfully integrated teams, established a talent management framework, and improved bid process efficiency. Promoted a culture of innovation and cross-disciplinary collaboration, while supporting the business model's transition towards managed services and subscription options.

Led the expansive services and operations functions across Australia and New Zealand, including Field Services, National Service Centre, Call Centres, Logistics, and Supply Chain, overseeing a $20M OPEX budget. Throughout my tenure, I spearheaded several key transformations that streamlined operations, reduced the vendor pool from 38 to 2, resulting in substantial cost savings, and optimized service delivery through process improvements like insourcing repair operations and deploying Salesforce. Additionally, I led the implementation of a new field service network, drove contact centre enhancements, and facilitated the successful transformation of service centres and field operations.

Recognized for my leadership and commitment to fostering a high-trust, high-integrity work environment, I consistently received top leadership ratings in the Great Place to Work Survey. Key achievements included national implementation of 5S methodology as a global subject matter expert, achieving significant operational efficiencies, and successfully managing COVID Safe operations.

Oversaw service and support for the Myki Ticketing System across Victoria. Led global cross-functional teams, enhancing performance and productivity. Served as a pivotal member of the Senior Management Team and VP of Field Operations' deputy. Managed diverse vendor relationships, optimizing service contracts, SLAs, and negotiations. Key achievements include the transformation of Myki equipment to NextGen, securing a significant annual support deal, and surpassing KPI targets. Successfully accelerated the NextGen Myki Ticketing System's rollout and prudently managed budgets, achieving notable cost savings.

experiences.position: Head of Service Operations and Supply Chain
experiences.description: Oversaw service relationships for major banks including Suncorp, NAB, Bank of Queensland, and Westpac. Achievements include significantly improving customer turn-around-time, halving repair backlog, and transforming invoicing to boost monthly revenue. Implemented enterprise reporting tools, streamlined financial management, and reduced operating costs. Led a high-performing diverse team, managed vendor relations, and surpassed delivery expectations by distributing devices nationwide ahead of schedule

experiences.position: National Operations Manager / State Manager (Victoria, Tasmania)
experiences.description: Oversaw Service Delivery for major clients including Sun Microsystems, Hewlett Packard, and Macquarie Bank. Accountable for operational and financial outcomes for Vic/Tas operations and temporarily managed National Operations. Achievements include boosting net profit from 25% to 48%, leading a program to reengineer work practices, and achieving Board buy-in for merging three AWA locations. Presided over the team that won AWA Branch of the Year in 2004 and 2005. Met all SLAs, doubled staff productivity, and implemented significant cost-saving measures, including decommissioning the Tasmania branch and restructuring management. Improved business SLAs from 84% to 100% and enhanced field SLAs by 11%.

Oversaw service operations for Motorola, a global leader in secure mobile technology. Redefined organizational structure, revitalized team morale, and enhanced operational efficiency. Key achievements include devising a restructure strategy that boosted revenues from $585K to $1 million per month. Led a high-performing team, achieving 100% response times and reducing repeat repair rates by 52%. Introduced barcoding, slashing data entry errors and saving 30% in operational time. Streamlined parts ordering, achieving 98+% inventory accuracy and reducing unit delays by 97.5%.
